description.text: New student should take Entrance Examination before attending classes, arranged as follows: Arts: Chinese, Math, English, Arts comprehensive exam (Arts comprehensive exam includes: Background of China and mordern world history) Science: Chinese, Math, English and Science comprehensive exam (Science Comprehensive exam includes: physics, chemistry and biology)

duration.text: The Economics at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3444 USD/per year ￥ 24800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 5 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be over 18 years in age 2. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. HSK level 5 or above 4. Recommendation from at least two teachers with titles of or above associate-professor 5. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 6. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits. 7. Be in good health condition
